items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And Joe Murphy, the drums. He was, he joined me after Ace Harris was with me.

ctx.x: LeRoy Kirkland, the guitar. He did a lot of writing for me. He was with the old Sunset Royal band too. So, William McLamore was playing guitar with me when he first left the school. But, he decided to put it down and he went into a business.
And Joe Murphy, the drums. He was, he joined me after Ace Harris was with me. Ace Harris, pianist? Ace Harris followed Avery Parrish. Avery went out on his own.
Ace Harris followed him. I just took Ace Harris up to my apartment and played a record of "After Hours". I said if you play piano good, you've got to play "After Hours" because
